Package com.neueda.leap.passwordreset

Class PasswordResetToken

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.passwordreset.PasswordResetToken
@Entity public class PasswordResetToken extends Object
Represents a temporary token that authorizes a password reset.

      public PasswordResetToken(UUID id, String tokenHash, UUID userId, Instant expiresAt)
      Creates a password reset token.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the reset token
      tokenHash - the hashed password reset token
      userId - the identifier of the user requesting the reset
      expiresAt - the time at which the reset token expires
